scope: T1.1 template, browser-free validator, delivery guidance, and faithful copied baseline/clarity examples only. No new capture/edit or full harness.

format.filename: evidence.json beside each reel in its own delivery folder
format.takes: References to preserved raw take records; driver event indices resolve existing timestamps without rewriting them.
format.clocks: Driver time and encoded output time are separate; edit maps relate encoded input/output only. Unknown alignment stays unknown.
format.checks: Raw reports including failures, errors and compatibility warnings remain authoritative. Structural validation does not decode media or certify visual, listening, privacy or publication quality.
format.review: Explicit coverage/status and evidence, including unavailable review and timed watch/privacy findings. Empty findings alone never imply reviewed.
format.edit_only: No new capture settings or take; source takes and input footage referenced with saved edit settings.

local_validation.environment: 3.14.2 on macOS; no browser or media executables used for evidence validation
faithful_examples: baseline: pass, 15–30 second silent brief, full-range warning retained
clarity: pass, 10–11 second silent brief, edit-only timeline and review gaps retained
local_validation.legacy_format: Preserved original baseline record fails missing versioned fields. This demonstrates format incompatibility, not a bad video.
local_validation.source_integrity: Recorder, emphasis, media checker, preflight, and their accepted tests match published bytes. Existing take/check copies match their copy manifest; only two checker video-path fields sanitized.
local_validation.discovery: Cached skills CLI add . --list finds record-product-demo among six; no install.
local_validation.plan: Original task statuses, dependencies, and acceptance criteria unchanged; new test command added to mechanical_suite.

independent_validation.author: ChatGPT review partner
independent_validation.source: Self-contained review findings in this conversation; no independent archive sought or inspected.

independent_validation.acceptance: Pending review of this attribution correction; original mechanical findings remain attributed to the earlier candidate.

limitations: Two independent S1 agent runs remain unverified; original T1.1 remains pending with T0.7 dependency.
Copied historical review coverage is not a fresh continuous-watch or privacy review.
The validator checks recorded assertions and local consistency, not their external truth. Complex or unavailable edit mappings remain explicitly unknown.
handoff: Evidence-file packet published. The separately assigned beat-frame extraction/index/contact-sheet slice remains uncommitted for review. Original prerequisites remain open; no merge or installed-skill replacement.
